summary: Checkout rejects a valid 20% promotion at the inclusive expiry boundary.
root_cause: Probable off-by-one comparison in PromotionValidator: now >= expiresAt rejects equality, contrary to the inclusive requirement.

claims.text: The contract accepts a promotion when now equals expiresAt.
The failed checkout recorded equal timestamps and PROMO_EXPIRED.
Release 2.14 introduced the >= comparison; a previous coupon bug used the same boundary pattern.

alternatives: Clock skew: compare application and database clocks before concluding.
Stale promotion cache: invalidate cache and repeat with a fresh promotion.
next_steps: Confirm the deployed commit matches source evidence.
Replace >= with > if product confirms the inclusive contract.
Run before, equal, and after expiry regression checks in isolated staging.
mode: OFFLINE DEMO · fixture analysis · no LLM calls

evidence.title: Checkout expiry request trace req-71
evidence.text: 2026-09-01T12:00:00.000Z request_id=req-71 service=checkout code=SAVE20 now=2026-09-01T12:00:00.000Z expiresAt=2026-09-01T12:00:00.000Z status=422 error=PROMO_EXPIRED subtotal=10000 release=2.14

evidence.title: Promotion boundary acceptance
evidence.text: Given a 20 percent coupon expiring at 2026-09-01T12:00:00.000Z, quotes at -1ms and equal expiry return 200 and total 8000; +1ms returns 422 PROMO_EXPIRED.

evidence.title: checkout-expiry CI run 8812
evidence.text: Pipeline checkout-api run 8812, release 2.14, commit b7a19f2. Chromium checkout expiry test failed on first and retry attempts: expected 200 received 422 PROMO_EXPIRED. 117 passed, 1 failed. Trace is referenced but not analyzed.

evidence.title: PromotionValidator source at commit b7a19f2
evidence.text: checkout/PromotionValidator.ts:42 at b7a19f2: if (now >= expiresAt) throw new PromoExpired(); return subtotal * 0.8; Deployed commit must be confirmed. Playwright checkout expiry assertion expected HTTP 200 but received 422.

evidence.title: Promotion expiry test gaps
evidence.text: TC-88 tests one hour before expiry and one hour after. Exact equality was missing. Add three cases at -1, 0 and +1 milliseconds. Checkout total must remain integer minor units.

evidence.title: Checkout quote API schema
evidence.text: POST /checkout/quote requires code:string and subtotal:integer minor units. Local-only now:date-time injects clock. Responses: 200 {total:integer}; 422 {error:PROMO_EXPIRED}; 404 {error:UNKNOWN_CODE}. Promo rate 20 percent. Equality is accepted.

evidence.title: Promotion checkout incident 2026-09-01
evidence.text: Between 12:00:00 and 12:00:02 UTC checkout rejected 38 promotion quotes. Only expiring codes affected. Payment authorization unaffected. Cache reset did not change observed failures.

evidence.title: SHOP-142 inclusive checkout promotion
evidence.text: As a shopper I can apply SAVE20 through its expiry instant. Priority High; component checkout; release 2.14. Owner Payments QA. Linked requirement REQ-001.

evidence.title: Promotion expiry contract
evidence.text: Checkout promotions remain valid when now <= expiresAt. A 20 percent promotion on subtotal 10000 yields total 8000. Times use UTC millisecond precision.

evidence.title: Checkout clock and fixture guide
evidence.text: Production checkout takes now from the server clock. Local fixture API accepts now explicitly for deterministic tests. POST /test-support/promotions {expiresAt} returns {code}. POST /checkout/quote {code,subtotal,now} returns {total} or {error}. Test support must never be enabled in production.

evidence.title: SHOP-89 gift-card inclusive boundary
evidence.text: A prior gift-card defect rejected valid credit at equality due to >= comparison. Fix changed condition to > with an exact-boundary regression. Similarity supports a hypothesis, not proof.

evidence.title: Inventory reservation contention / ci_failures
evidence.text: Build stock-321 / Java17 / commit 7d12abc: concurrentReservation test expected one 409 but got [201,201]; 240 passed, 1 failed. Retries disabled to preserve race evidence.

evidence.title: Checkout release 2.14 changes
evidence.text: Release 2.14 commit b7a19f2 unified promotion validation. PromotionValidator comparison changed from now > expiresAt to now >= expiresAt. Canary only tested non-boundary quotes. No requirement change recorded.

evidence.title: Inventory reservation contention / historical_defects
evidence.text: INV-117 resolved in 3.0: a read-modify-write stock decrement caused oversell under contention. Fix used SELECT FOR UPDATE in one transaction; no evidence yet that the same code path is deployed in 3.2.

evidence.title: Checkout release clock configuration
evidence.text: checkout 2.14: TZ=UTC, clockPrecision=millisecond, promoCacheTtlSeconds=30. NTP offset observed +0.3ms. Compare request and database clocks during investigation; configuration alone cannot exclude skew.

evidence.title: Tenant cache isolation / ci_failures
evidence.text: Identity pipeline 588 / commit 91abcee: tenantIsolation test expected South User, received North User after warming cache. Test passes with profileCacheEnabled=false.

evidence.title: Inventory reservation contention / incidents
evidence.text: INC-002 2026-08-29 09:10Z: four oversold SKUs during sale. 12 orders backordered. Rate rose after stock-service 3.2 rollout; rollback stopped new oversells. Existing orders required manual reconciliation.

evidence.title: Inventory reservation contention / test_cases
evidence.text: TC-204: Seed isolated SKU with stock=1. Send two concurrent POST reservations using different keys. Assert statuses [201,409] and GET stock=0. Replay the winning key and assert same reservation ID.

evidence.title: Inventory reservation contention / acceptance_criteria
evidence.text: AC1: stock=1 and two concurrent requests yields one 201, one 409. AC2: replaying a successful idempotency key leaves stock unchanged. AC3: stock never becomes negative.

evidence.title: Inventory reservation contention / api_specs
evidence.text: POST /reservations {sku,quantity} plus Idempotency-Key. 201 {reservationId}; 409 {error:OUT_OF_STOCK}. GET /stock/{sku} returns {available:integer}. No external payments occur during reservation.

evidence.title: Tenant cache isolation / api_specs
evidence.text: GET /profile requires bearer JWT with tenantId and sub. 200 {tenantId,userId,displayName,roles}. 401 for missing tenant. Tenant is derived from verified token, never query parameters.

evidence.title: Tenant cache isolation / incidents
evidence.text: INC-003 2026-08-30: synthetic monitor found cross-tenant displayName after profile cache rollout. Feature flag disabled pending review. No verified production personal-data exposure in this dataset.

evidence.title: Tenant cache isolation / logs
evidence.text: 10:03:00 tenant=north sub=42 cache=miss key=profile:42; 10:03:01 tenant=south sub=42 cache=hit key=profile:42 returnedTenant=north request=auth-91.

evidence.title: Tenant cache isolation / release_notes
evidence.text: 5.8 commit 91abcee introduced shared Redis profile cache. Per-tenant process-local cache was removed. Release tests used globally unique subjects, masking key collisions.

evidence.title: Tenant cache isolation / automation_source
evidence.text: identity/ProfileCache.ts:31: const key = `profile:${userId}`; cache.get(key). The key omits tenantId. Middleware correctly extracts tenantId from verified token.

evidence.title: Tenant cache isolation / test_cases
evidence.text: TC-311: Create synthetic tenants north and south with userId=42 and different displayNames. Warm north, fetch south, compare full body; reverse order and test cache expiry.
